title: Sunsets on Savannah Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sunsets on Savannah is a completely renovated, one-bedroom cottage with a king bedroom, sleeping four, only 118 feet to the private beach in Seaside, Florida! Walk to over 35 shops & restaurants from your door.
description_expanded: Description21 SAVANNAH STREETKING, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA - (sleeps 4)Coastal Guest Cottage in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Sunsets on Savannah, a charming and stylish guest cottage nestled in one of Seaside, Florida’s most desirable locations. This modern coastal retreat is the guest cottage to the main home, Goodobbies, and comfortably accommodates up to four guests—making it ideal for couples, small families, or close friends seeking a relaxed beach getaway along Scenic Highway 30A. Perfectly positioned just 118 feet from the private beach access at Savannah Pavilion and only a five-minute walk to Seaside’s Central Square, this cottage places you steps from the sugar-white sand and the vibrant heart of town.Prime Location Near the Beach & Town CenterSunsets on Savannah offers the best of Seaside living with effortless access to both the beach and downtown amenities. From iconic Seaside architecture to locally loved restaurants, boutiques, and outdoor events, everything is within easy walking distance. Guests enjoy private parking located down a long driveway, allowing for convenient unloading before strolling to the guest cottage and beginning their Seaside escape.Bright Living Space & First-Level ComfortsStep inside the first level to an airy, thoughtfully designed living area featuring modern coastal décor and an inviting layout. The living room includes a queen sleeper sofa, accommodating two additional guests, along with a flat-screen plasma TV for relaxing evenings. A washer and dryer are conveniently located nearby, adding ease to longer stays. Just off the living area, a renovated full bathroom offers a walk-in shower and single vanity, blending functionality with fresh, beach-inspired finishes.Private King Suite & Kitchenette UpstairsA wooden spiral staircase leads to the upper-level open king suite, a serene retreat designed for rest and relaxation. This space features a plush king-sized bed, a plasma flat-screen TV, and a half bath, creating a private oasis above it all. Adjacent to the sleeping area is a well-appointed efficiency kitchenette, equipped with an under-counter refrigerator, small bar sink, microwave, and toaster—perfect for preparing light meals or beach-day snacks. The kitchenette flows seamlessly into bar-top seating for two, an ideal spot for morning coffee or casual dining.Your Ideal Seaside, FL GetawayWith its unbeatable proximity to the beach, walkable access to downtown Seaside, and thoughtfully designed interiors, Sunsets on Savannah is a delightful coastal bungalow perfect for your next Florida vacation. Whether you’re spending sun-soaked days on Seaside’s private beach or enjoying evenings in town, this guest home offers a welcoming and convenient home base for experiencing the very best of Seaside, Florida.Need more room, Sunsets on Savannah is the guest cottage to Goodobbies a 3BD main home that sleeps 8 in all.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESFeatures: 476 square feet118 feet to private beach access at Savannah PavilionPrivate Seaside residential beach with access to the largest private beaches on 30AFull-size washer & dryerEfficiency kitchenPrivate driveway exclusive to Sunsets on SavannahEV charger available for guest useAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
